name: In2 Cart Recovery & Notifications
author: iN2 LLC

sections.description:
In2 Cart Recovery & Notifications connects your WooCommerce store to the WPP Marketing service so order, cart, and customer events can trigger WhatsApp marketing automations.

Use it to send WooCommerce events to WPP Marketing for WhatsApp cart recovery, automated order notifications, delivery notifications, abandoned cart recovery, customer segmentation, and remarketing campaigns via WhatsApp.

The plugin is designed for stores that already use WPP Marketing or want a simple way to connect WooCommerce events to WhatsApp marketing workflows, including WooCommerce WhatsApp notifications and abandoned checkout recovery.

If you do not have a WPP Marketing account yet, create one at https://wppmarketing.com before configuring the plugin. Your API URL and token are available in your WPP Marketing integration settings.

Supported events:

  • Cart created
  • Abandoned checkout
  • Order created
  • Order paid
  • Order shipped/completed
  • Order cancelled
  • Customer created

The plugin sends event data to the WPP Marketing Events API using the token configured by the store administrator.

External services

This plugin connects to the WPP Marketing service to send WooCommerce event data for WhatsApp marketing automation.

The plugin sends data only after the store administrator configures an API URL, enters a WPP Marketing token, and enables the integration in the plugin settings.

Data sent to WPP Marketing may include event type, cart ID, order ID, order number, order total, currency, payment method, payment or tracking links when available, customer name, phone, email, country, state, and city.

Service endpoint used by default: https://api.wppmarketing.com/events/

WPP Marketing service information: https://en.wppmarketing.com/developer
WPP Marketing privacy policy: https://en.wppmarketing.com/privacy-policy
WPP Marketing terms of use: https://es.wppmarketing.com/terms-of-use

WhatsApp is a trademark of Meta Platforms, Inc. This plugin is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or otherwise connected to WhatsApp or Meta Platforms, Inc.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/in2-cart-recovery-notifications-for-wpp-marketing directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Create a WPP Marketing account at https://wppmarketing.com if you do not already have one.
  4. In WPP Marketing, open the integration settings and copy your API URL and token.
  5. Go to WooCommerce > In2 Cart Recovery.
  6. Enter your API URL and WPP Marketing token.
  7. Enable the events you want to send.
  8. Use Test connection to confirm the API connection.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be active for store events to be captured.

Do I need a WPP Marketing account?

Yes. You need a WPP Marketing account to generate the API URL and token used by this plugin. If you do not have an account yet, visit https://wppmarketing.com.

Where do I find my API URL and token?

Open your WPP Marketing account and go to the integration settings. Copy the API URL and token, then paste them into WooCommerce > In2 Cart Recovery in WordPress.

What data is sent to WPP Marketing?

The plugin sends event type, order ID, order number, order total, currency, payment method, payment or tracking links when available, customer name, phone, email, country, state, and city.

Can I use this for WhatsApp cart recovery?

Yes. The plugin can send cart created and abandoned checkout events to WPP Marketing so your store can run WhatsApp cart recovery and abandoned cart recovery automations.

Can I use this for WooCommerce order notifications?

Yes. The plugin can send order created, paid, shipped/completed, and cancelled events to WPP Marketing for WooCommerce WhatsApp order notifications.

Is this plugin affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta?

No. WhatsApp is a trademark of Meta Platforms, Inc. This plugin is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or otherwise connected to WhatsApp or Meta Platforms, Inc. It connects WooCommerce stores to the WPP Marketing service for WhatsApp marketing automation.

Does this plugin support High-Performance Order Storage?

Yes. The plugin uses WooCommerce order APIs and declares compatibility with custom order tables.
